note: Ten practical experiment directions, not ten empirically best combinations. Extra Hindi songs are listening candidates, never counted as musical support. No zone has demonstrated causal or adjusted performance effect.

zones.name: Intimate minor ballad
zones.supporting_count_definition: Selected source-reported examples; not trials, not independent datasets, and examples may recur in other zones.
zones.production_and_hook_experiment: Try a spacious original verse and a clearer, wider refrain; hold accompaniment back until the emotional pivot.
zones.production_description_kind: Coordinator proposal to audition, not measured property of every reference
zones.vocal_implications_and_test: Audition the sustained chorus phrase in a comfortable key, then one semitone lower/higher only if comfortable. Prioritize phrase-end stability.

performance_characteristics.signal: Successful-list presence in source cohorts, not evidence of a zone advantage
performance_characteristics.normalization_limit: B counters lack exact as-of; lifetime-average only. Do not compare this median across zones/markets as treatment effect.

zones.evidence_strength: Low for musical transfer; no estimated performance association
zones.caveat: Pehle Bhi Main is reported at 77; arrangement pulse conflicts remain. Extra Hindi titles are success/listening references, with mode/BPM null.
zones.study_only: Abstract groove, section contrast, density, repetition with variation; write original melody, lyrics and riffs. No sample or expressive passage clearance is implied.
